title: engine_profile
description: Standardized engine profile of an engine_backend workload: the same keys for every engine. A leaf is a value or {na: reason}; a blank is a decision. Facts and hazards only, never solutions.

na.description: Explicitly not applicable, with the reason.

name.description: Engine id: lowercase identifier, equals the workload's engine_name.

sdk_headers.description: Headers / SDK roots the backend compiles against.

docs.description: Engine documentation the agent may consult.

packaging.description: How the backend is delivered into the engine.

placement_candidates.description: S6 placements this engine can host.

requires_in_process_host.description: True when S7 entry points must load inside the engine (layer host runs).

install_path.description: Where the artifact must be installed for the engine to load it.

test_only_code_rule.description: Fact about which artifact may hold test-only code.

host_runtime.description: The environment the gates run the engine in.

ninja_targets_env.description: Env var carrying the ninja targets to the build script.

binary_dir.description: Where harness binaries are built (inside the container).

connect.description: How a client reaches the engine from the host and from inside the host.

cmake_option.description: The CMake option that enables this engine's backend.

extra_find_packages.description: find_package / module names beyond the engine SDK.

process_model.description: How the engine runs user work.

shared_memory_needed.description: Whether state shared by all connections needs OS shared memory.

engine_api_thread_safety.description: Which threads may call engine APIs.

calls_forbidden_off_main_thread.description: Engine calls that are unsafe off the thread that owns the session.

hook_mechanism.description: The engine's own way to see row changes.

granularity.description: Unit one hook invocation covers (row, statement, ...), and what it sees of old/new values.

ddl_events.description: How TRUNCATE / DROP / RENAME / replace of a table become observable; none if they do not.

uncaptured_write_paths.description: Write paths that bypass the hook (bulk load, DDL, replication apply).

commit_hook.description: Callbacks around commit and what each may do.

commit_order_source.description: The engine's own clock that orders commits in visibility order.

own_writes_visibility.description: What a read inside a writing transaction sees of its uncommitted rows.

snapshot_api.description: How a reader's snapshot is obtained, named, and compared with commits.

subtransactions.description: Savepoint support and how their abort is signalled.

locking.description: Engine locks that interact with backend code.

engine_locks_relevant.description: Engine locks taken by reads, scans and DDL, with their lifetime.

locks_held_during_hooks.description: Engine locks the engine holds while it calls capture / commit hooks.

wait_timeout_knob.description: Setting that bounds an engine lock wait.

parallel_scan_api.description: Engine support for partitioned or parallel reads at one snapshot.

row_count_source.description: Cheap row-count estimate and its freshness.

type_quirks.description: Numeric, date, text-width or NULL representation facts that differ from a plain C++ type.

collation_quirks.description: How text compares and orders versus bytewise.

mechanism.description: How the engine registers and calls a function / table function.

result_return.description: How rows and types return to the engine.

registration_symbol.description: Pattern of the per-query registration symbol the accelerators of this engine export ({Bench}: CamelCase benchmark, {N}: query number), or n/a when the engine has none.

mechanism.description: Where settings live (GUC, system variable, pragma, env) and who can set them.

reload_semantics.description: When a changed setting takes effect.

sql_client.description: The engine's own client for running SQL against the reference database (a fact, not a repository script).

engine_fact.description: The engine behaviour that causes it. A fact, never a fix.

layers.description: Implementation layers the fact matters to.

hazards.description: Hard-won engine facts as symptom + cause.

query_host.description: How accelerator runs reach this engine's query host.

dataset_env.description: Env var carrying the dataset location to harness binaries.

work_db_suffix.description: Suffix of per-worker copies of the engine's database.

data_sql.description: How tools reach the engine's data with SQL (host.sh sql). Optional; the defaults are the sqlglot-neutral dialect and information_schema.

dialect.description: sqlglot dialect name of the engine's SQL (the dialect names sqlglot lists): the statements data tools emit are transpiled to it.

catalog_columns_sql.description: A statement listing (table_name, column_name, data_type) of the dataset's tables, for engines without information_schema.columns.
